review_candidates.title: Vice President, Investments
review_candidates.description: American Operator is seeking a Vice President of Investments to lead the end-to-end acquisition of small- to medium-sized businesses, shaping American Operator’s portfolio for long-term growth and operational excellence. This is a senior individual contributor role where you will own deal execution, drive high-quality investment decisions, and serve as a key partner to leadership across the investment lifecycle. You will run-point on small business acquisitions from LOI to close, managing diligence, negotiations, and underwriting. You will be the primary point-of-contact for the retiring owners we partner with as well as the operators we back, requiring strong relationship management and communication skills. The ideal candidate for this role has a strong mix of EQ and IQ, are familiar with small business owners, and have experience with closing acquisitions of Main Street- or Lower Middle Market deals. Responsibilities Own the deal lifecycle from offer through close, with accountability for deal quality, pacing, and outcomes. Evaluate and prioritize investment opportunities, forming clear perspectives and recommendations on where to deploy capital. Serve as the primary point of contact for business owners, building trust and navigating complex, high-emotion transactions. Lead structuring, negotiation, and execution of transactions, ensuring alignment with firm strategy and risk-return objectives. Partner with operators and leadership on post-close integration and value creation initiatives. Partner with leadership on sourcing strategy and pipeline development, helping maintain a consistent flow of high-quality opportunities. Work closely with internal stakeholders and external advisors throughout diligence and execution. Represent the firm externally with intermediaries, advisors, and within the SMB ecosystem. Minimum Qualifications 8+ years of relevant experience in private equity and/or investment banking. Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, or related field. Demonstrated experience owning transaction execution from sourcing through close. Deep expertise in financial modeling, structuring, and negotiations. Diverse industry experience, with a preference for distribution, manufacturing or services businesses. Strong investment judgment and ability to evaluate businesses holistically, including operational and strategic considerations. Proven ability to manage multiple transactions simultaneously in a fast-paced environment. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence internal and external stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications MBA from a top-tier program. Experience working with or investing in small and medium-sized businesses. Personal connection to small businesses or passion for preserving the American Dream. Experience with lower middle market / SMB acquisitions. Compensation The anticipated base salary range for this position is listed below. Total compensation may also include a discretionary performance-based bonus and equity. Please note that compensation is determined based on a variety of factors, including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, education, skills, and other qualifications specific to the role. $160K - $220K LOCATION Candidates based in Austin, New York City, or the surrounding areas will be expected to commute to and work from our local office. Candidates outside of these regions may work remotely. Periodic travel to both Austin and New York City will be required regardless of location. About The Team American Operator exists because we believe the American Dream is worth protecting, and that small businesses are the backbone of our communities. To do this well, we need a team that reflects the real world: operators, builders, investors, and problem-solvers from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences. MISSION-DRIVEN Every company claims to be mission-driven, but our mission is simple, tangible, and urgent: preserve the legacy of America’s small businesses and create more pathways to meaningful ownership. We partner with operators who want to step into leadership, take responsibility for great companies, and continue the work that founders spent decades building. When we succeed, communities keep their employers, families keep their livelihoods, and operators get the chance to build wealth through real ownership. We work hard because we know what’s at stake: generational businesses that deserve to thrive, and talented operators who deserve the chance to lead them. And while we measure our success in deals closed and businesses grown, the real reward is seeing these companies continue to serve their people and their towns, stronger than before. Where else do you get the opportunity to help someone become a CEO, preserve a founder’s life’s work, and strengthen a community, all in the same job? That’s what makes our work both serious and incredibly fulfilling.

review_candidates.title: Trade Compliance Manager
review_candidates.description: About The Role & Team At Disney, our stories, products and experiences reach audiences and guests around the world. As Trade Compliance Manager, you will play an important role in helping those products move across borders in a compliant, efficient and responsible way. Supporting import and export activity across the UK and EU, you will help the business navigate customs requirements, manage trade risk, reduce duty exposure and enable smooth cross-border operations. You will work closely with teams across Disney, as well as customs brokers, logistics partners, government agencies and external vendors, building trusted relationships and providing practical guidance that supports our people, our partners and the wider business. This is a collaborative role for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, improving processes and contributing to a culture where everyone can do their best work. This role is based in our London Hammersmith office, with an expectation to work onsite four days per week. Values You’ll join a team grounded in our Disney values, acting with Integrity, welcoming everyone through Inclusion, embracing boundless Creativity, working together through Collaboration and caring deeply for our Community. These values shape how we work and how we support one another every day. What You Will Do I mport Compliance (UK & EU) Ensure accurate and compliant import declarations, including classification, valuation, origin determination, and duty calculation Review import documentation for accuracy (commercial invoices, packing lists, origin certificates, product data) Maintain and update tariff classification databases (UK Global Tariff, EU TARIC) Apply preferential trade programs where applicable (e.g., EU FTAs, UK FTAs, Rules of Origin) Partner with customs brokers to resolve clearance issues, exams, holds, or post‑entry corrections Monitor regulatory changes from HMRC, UK Border Force, and EU customs bodies Export Compliance (UK & EU) Determine export control classifications (e.g., UK Export Control Order, EU Dual‑Use Regulation). Screen transactions for restricted parties, embargoed destinations, and licensing requirements Ensure compliant export filings and documentation (export declarations, licenses, commercial paperwork) Oversee proper procedures for temporary exports, returns, and repairs Coordinate with freight forwarders to ensure timely and compliant outbound shipments Governance, Risk & Operational Excellence Develop and maintain compliance Store Operating Procedures (SOPs) for UK and EU processes Conduct audits, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions for compliance gaps Provide guidance to internal teams (Merchandise, Sourcing, Product Development, etc.) on customs and export requirements Support trade compliance training across business units Escalate trade risks and propose mitigation strategies to leadership Collaborative Functions Coordinate with TWDC Tax dept for VAT, Duty management Work jointly with Finance & Accounts to calculate and monitor the application of duty and freight factors used to calculate the landed cost of imported products Apply for relevant import licenses to ensure product can be imported Ensure all Import Standard Operating Procedure is routinely followed thus ensuring comprehensive and timely shipment and clearance of goods through to the DC(s) Liaise with the global logistics partners and other TWDC supply chain entities to develop and implement progressive initiatives and industry best practice Compile and issue defined periodic reporting and ad-hoc supporting information to illustrate key statistics, data and business or financial impact Maintain awareness of and excellent functional relationships with TDSE and external department leadership / stakeholders. review_candidates.description: Tendering Engineer - Field Services Location - Dublin, Ireland What will you do? As part of a Services Business Unit, the role of tender engineer is to: Support the Sales Team by ensuring we understand the customers commercial and technical requirements and are able to submit a technically compliant offer in line with the customers technical requirements and scope of supply as detailed in their Request for Quotation, or otherwise noted in our commercial and/or technical offers by deviations, exclusions or clarifications. It is also the responsibility of the Tendering team to ensure that any offer submitted to our customer is commercially competitive while staying at or above the required margin levels from the business and has approval from the required Approver and SME’s dependent on the value and complexity of the project or service being offered. Support the Operations Team to ensure that the scope of supply being offered at tender stage is within their ability to deliver from a scope of supply, resource and competence point of view and costed accordingly. It is also the responsibility of the Tendering team to, identify, remove and mitigate risk where possible and/or allow a sufficient risk provision for risks that can not be removed or mitigated at the tender stage to enable the Operations team to successfully deliver the project and maintain the as tendered margin. Job Specific Requirements: Close collaboration with the opportunity leader to understand the opportunity requirement / Scope / Specification / Needs and Develop Customer request into a Schneider Electric’s offer by developing a proposal that is in line with the Client requirements in the most cost-effective manner. Provide tendering expertise in Maintenance, Repair & Modernisation for existing installed base and customers for Power Services specifically Low Voltage & Medium Voltage Electrical Distribution Equipment. Ensure compliance to internal policies and process requirements. Prepare a detailed cost analysis based on market and/or bid competitiveness and value proposition. Coordinate & work with Factories, Internal Group and External Group to build up a proper service offer responding to specific RFQ requirements. Lead and be responsible for tender approval review with SME and Business Unit Approvers Provide accurate and approved tender to opportunity leader within SLA. Support Sales team by participating in bid clarification. Communicate and coordinate with all internal stakeholders such as Sales, Finance, Operation, Engineering, purchasing to obtain the optimized offer solution. Ensure complete and proper hand over of won opportunity to Services Operation team. Previous working experience preferably in Sales, Tendering or Project Management of LV & MV Electrical Distribution Equipment. Knowledge or experience of installation, testing, commissioning and maintaining LV & MV Electrical Distribution Equipment used in different market segments and environments. review_candidates.title: Snowflake Engineer
review_candidates.location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
review_candidates.description: Firm Overview Lunate is a new Abu Dhabi-based, Partner-led, independent global alternative investment manager with more than 250 employees and $115 billion of assets under management. Lunate invests across the entire private markets spectrum including buyouts, growth equity, early and late-stage venture capital, private credit, real assets, and public equities and public credit. Lunate aims to be one of the world’s leading private markets solutions providers through SMAs and multi-asset class funds, seeking to generate best-in-class risk-adjusted returns for its clients. Job Purpose The Senior Data Engineer will be the first dedicated internal data engineering hire in Lunate’s Data & AI function. This role is responsible for building dependable ingestion and transformation pipelines into Snowflake, shaping high-quality, well-modelled datasets that power reporting, operations, and AI-enabled products. You will work closely with the Head of Data & AI and partner with Infrastructure (who own Snowflake account and platform setup) to deliver a modern, data-as-code engineering practice with strong controls, testing, and repeatability, supporting both BI and AI/Agentic workloads. Key Duties and Responsibilities Build and own ingestion pipelines into Snowflake using modern ELT patterns (Fivetran or equivalent, plus custom ingestion where needed), handling schema drift and source changes safely. Leverage AI Tools to design and automate our pipelines. Implement a layered data architecture (raw, standardised, business) that preserves immutability, auditability, and supports reprocessing and backfills. Develop transformations as version-controlled code (SQL and Python) using dbt or equivalent tooling. Apply pragmatic data modelling practices, using dimensional (Kimball) or relational approaches where appropriate. Build data quality and reconciliation into pipelines, with automated checks and visible quality signals. Operate pipelines like software: CI/CD, automated testing, peer review, and controlled promotion across environments. Optimise Snowflake usage for performance and cost, working with Infrastructure on governance controls. Partner with BI practitioners and AI engineers to deliver AI-ready datasets with consistent semantics and clear lineage. Collaborate with investment, operations, and finance teams to translate requirements into robust data products. Contribute to engineering standards, patterns, and documentation as the data function scales. Qualifications and Experience 6+ years of professional data engineering experience delivering production pipelines. Strong experience with Snowflake’s full suite of products – especially core functionality. Hands-on experience with dbt, including testing and environment management. Familiarity with modern ingestion tools such as Fivetran. Strong grounding in data modelling fundamentals (Kimball and relational). Python-native, comfortable writing production-quality pipeline and orchestration code. Strong software engineering discipline applied to data (Git, CI/CD, automated testing). Experience building replayable, idempotent pipelines with backfill support. Financial services experience preferred, with understanding of audit, restatement, and as-of data concepts.

review_candidates.title: Senior Lead People Technology & Reporting
review_candidates.description: Who We Are SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners -- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. Our vision is to shape the future of audio, where everyone can be effortlessly connected to the voices, stories and music they love wherever they are. This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically-acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day. SiriusXM is the leading audio entertainment company in North America, and the premier programmer and platform for subscription and digital advertising-supported audio products. SiriusXM’s platforms collectively reach approximately 150 million listeners, the largest digital audio audience across paid and free tiers in North America, and deliver music, sports, talk, news, comedy, entertainment and podcasts. Pandora, a subsidiary of SiriusXM, is the largest ad-supported audio entertainment streaming service in the U.S. SiriusXM's subsidiaries Simplecast and AdsWizz make it a leader in podcast hosting, production, distribution, analytics and monetization. The Company’s advertising sales organization, which operates as SiriusXM Media, leverages its scale, cross-platform sales organization and ad tech capabilities to deliver results for audio creators and advertisers. SiriusXM, through SiriusXM Canada Holdings, Inc., also offers satellite radio and audio entertainment in Canada. In addition to its audio entertainment businesses, SiriusXM offers connected vehicle services to automakers. How You’ll Make An Impact The Senior Lead, People Technology & Reporting role supports the configuration, maintenance, and optimization of Workday Benefits and Absence Management to ensure accurate, compliant, and efficient execution of benefits administration and leave processes. Contributes to the successful delivery of annual Open Enrollment, ACA administration, and ongoing Benefits and Absence operations by maintaining system configuration, supporting reporting, and ensuring data integrity. Partners with People Operations, Payroll, and Total Rewards to resolve system issues, improve processes, and enhance the employee experience. Strengthens People Technology capabilities through reliable production support, standardized configuration, quality assurance, and continuous process improvements that increase operational efficiency and reduce manual effort. This is an individual contributor role. What You'll Do Contribute to the development of a comprehensive People Technology roadmap, including prioritization of key initiatives that support business and organizational goals. Drive execution of the People Technology strategy and roadmap, independently leading complex, high-impact initiatives from requirements through deployment and ongoing optimization. Serve as an advanced solutions architect for People Technology, evaluating, recommending, implementing, and supporting tools, features, integrations, and processes that improve P+C operations. Analyze complex workflows and business requirements to identify opportunities for automation, optimization, and improved user experiences through technical solutions and industry best practices. Provide advanced functional and technical expertise for core HCM administration and collaborate on the governance, quality, security, and integrity of people data. Serve as a subject matter expert across current and emerging People Technology platforms used at SiriusXM, including Workday. Stay current on People Technology trends and emerging capabilities and advise stakeholders on solutions that support organizational objectives. Apply advanced expertise in requirements definition, functional specifications, analysis and design, system configuration, testing, data conversion, deployment, and production support. Define and track key metrics to evaluate the effectiveness of technology solutions, reporting capabilities, and business processes. Partner with Enterprise Solutions and other cross-functional stakeholders to support vendor relationships and software partnerships. Develop comprehensive system documentation and enable users through training, knowledge sharing, and ongoing support. Drive change management activities for People Technology initiatives to support successful adoption and sustainable business outcomes. Collaborate with P+C, Enterprise Solutions, and other cross-functional stakeholders to provide technical guidance and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. Provide functional leadership and mentorship to People Technology professionals, sharing advanced expertise and helping develop capabilities across the team. Ensure People Technology solutions and processes support applicable data privacy, security, and SOX compliance requirements. What You'll Need Typically requires a minimum of 7 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 5 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 4 years experience; or equivalent experience. Extensive related experience in HR technology, HRIS, or People Technology, with advanced expertise in HCM system administration; Workday experience strongly preferred. Proven success independently leading complex, enterprise-wide People Technology initiatives and system implementations. Advanced HRIS knowledge across core HR processes, including applicant tracking, talent management, reporting, regulatory requirements, and compensation planning. Workday production support experience within a steady-state organization with a mature system environment. Previous Workday implementation experience, including configuration, testing, data conversion, deployment, and post-production support. Demonstrated ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable functional and technical solutions. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a focus on user experience, data quality, and operational efficiency. Experience defining metrics, developing reporting solutions, and using data to assess process and technology effectiveness. Ability to influence and provide technical guidance to stakeholders across functions and levels without direct authority. Demonstrated ability to mentor colleagues and provide functional leadership on complex technical work. Experience partnering on vendor relationships and software solutions. Knowledge of U.S. data privacy requirements and SOX compliance best practices. Strong communication, stakeholder management, documentation, and change management skills. Skills People Technology / Advanced Workday / Advanced HRIS Administration / Advanced Solutions Architecture / Advanced People Data and Reporting / Advanced Requirements Definition and Functional Design / Advanced Systems Implementation and Production Support / Advanced Process Optimization / Advanced Data Governance and Compliance / Advanced Stakeholder Management / Advanced Change Management / Advanced Technical Mentoring and Functional Leadership / Advanced At SiriusXM, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your background and experience. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary. We expect the base salary for this position to be in the range of $113,600 - $150,000 and will depend on your skills, qualifications, and experience. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary short-term and long-term incentives. We encourage all interested candidates to apply. Our goal at SiriusXM is to provide and maintain a work environment that fosters mutual respect, professionalism and cooperation. The requirements and duties described above may be modified or waived by the Company in its sole discretion without notice. R-2026-06-30

review_candidates.title: Senior Engineer - Database
review_candidates.description: The role / impact You will partner with database engineers and product development teams to ensure the resilience, quality, and performance of Xero's core database platform. By combining technical due diligence with modern AI tooling, you will help optimise day-to-day operations across our SQL Server fleet while proactively managing database risks, changes, and releases. In this role, you will play a central part in modernising our data architecture as we migrate services from SQL Server RDS to Aurora Postgres RDS. You will provide strategic guidance on query performance and database design, supporting product teams with deep technical insights to build sustainable, scalable infrastructure for millions of customers. The Team / How They Connect You will join a supportive and collaborative team of senior database engineers spread across Australia and New Zealand. The team works closely with internal product squads, acting as trusted advisers to solve complex database challenges through open communication and shared problem-solving. Through daily standups and regular technical collaboration, team members learn from one another while supporting continuous delivery across our database platforms. The team is currently working on / Initially, you will focus on Managing and optimising day-to-day operations across our extensive SQL Server and SQL Server RDS database fleet. Planning and executing end-to-end database migrations from SQL Server to Aurora Postgres RDS. Integrating AI tools into engineering workflows to increase efficiency in query analysis, risk identification, and proactive maintenance. Partnering with product development teams to consult on schema design, query tuning, and database observability using AWS tools. Where And How You Can Work This role is open to applicants based in New Zealand or Australia. We offer flexible working arrangements with no formal day-to-day in-office requirement, though you will have access to our local office spaces and will be invited to gather in person for key team events and connection days throughout the year. Here are some of the things we are looking for Deep expertise in SQL Server and SQL Server RDS, with a strong emphasis on query analysis and performance tuning. Practical experience or familiarity with Aurora Postgres RDS, alongside a desire to contribute to active database migration projects. A pragmatic approach to technical ownership, with the capability to identify risks early and implement sustainable solutions. Clear communication skills that enable you to translate database complexities for product teams and collaborate effectively across disciplines. Curiosity and openness to leveraging AI tools to streamline routine tasks and enhance engineering productivity. Apply even if your experience isn't a perfect match! At Xero, we hire based on your skills, passion, and the unique perspective you can bring to enhance our culture and team.
